tei:div.tei:p: (3)mtsho rgyal snyan brgyud phur pa'i bdag bskyed nyung ngur bsdus pa rig 'jin lam gyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (4)

shrī badz+ra ku mā ra la na mo/ 'dir rdo rje phur pa'i nyams len rgyun khyewar gyi rim pa cung zad zad 'god pa la/ dang po lcags sam drag po'i shing gi phur pa sor bcu gnyis pa zhig rten du btsugs nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ 'khor lo khro bo khro mo ste/ srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lhar/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ sems bskyed pa ni/ ngang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas la/ sna tshogs sems kyi rnam (5)'phrul tsam/ skye med 'gags med spros pa bral/ thabs shes byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la/ gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ dag pa'i (6)mchod pa bzhes su gsaul/ dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs dbang phyug sems can la/ dgos pa gsum phyir lus 'bul lo/ tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ bgegs la bka' bsko ba ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje (7)gzhon nu'i rig 'jin gyis/ bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la/ las dang 'phral rkyen gyur pa'i bgegs/ 'dod yon gtor mas tshim gyis la/ zhi dang byams pa'i sems kyis su/ gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ gal te mi 'gro 'chi byed na/ khro bo 'bar ba'i sprin chen pos/ rdul du brlag par gdon mi za/ rtsa sngags mthar hūm̐ bzhi brjod/ mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khro bo rdo rje gnod mjes kyis/ hūm̐ kā ra la bka' stsal te/ phyogs bcu (8)khro bo'i gdan bshams bsgom/ des kyang 'dod pa'i rgyal po bskul/ thugs las ma spros nyi gdan bcur/

phyogs skyong bcu po bkug nas bsgyel/ hūm̐/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus byas nas/ dbyar gyi char sprin lta bu'i mdog 'bar ba'i me dpung bzhin du gtibs/ bgegs kyi tshogs la phur bur thob/ nam yang g.yo 'gul med par bsam/ badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ mtshams gcod rjes su brda sgo dbye ba ni/ bh+rūm̐/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyis/ gdod nas gnyis (9)su med pa la/ ma rig 'khrul pas bcing pa yis/ log rtog mtshan ma'i sprin gyis sgribs/ dkyil 'khor zhal yang ma mthong bas/ bdag 'jug brda sgo dbye ru gsol/ de nas brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ logs sku phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal dang*/ sprul sku sras mchog kī la ya/ rnam gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ shinatu ngo mtshar che ba'i lhar/ brda dang gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo/ oṃ (10)shrī badz+ra ku mā ra dzñā na ma hā maṇ+ḍal sarba de wa a kā ro ma mi na mo/ de nas mkhon bcug sbyang ba ni/ hūm̐/ byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma dang*/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha/ thugs rjes brtse ba'i bde bar gshegs/ legs nyes stangs 'jin mkha' 'gro ma/ kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ thog ma med nas da lta'i bar/ ma rig 'khrul pas bdag non te/ sa sor thar dang byang chub sems/ rig 'jin nang gi sdom pa rnams/ nyams shing zhig ral ci mchis pa/ lta ba (11)seng ge nga ros bshags/ bsgom pa ting 'jin mes bsregs te/ spyod pa glang chen chur bkrus nas/ gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas te bshags/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ de nas byin dbab ni/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a la la ho/ hūm̐/ byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ sgrub mchog bdag la dbang cig bskur/ gnas mchog 'di ru byin cig phob/ rtsa sngags dang*/ a we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ sa ma (12)ya ja jaḥ de nas sman gtor rak+ta la/ ram̐ las me 'bar nyes skyon bsregs/

yam̐ las rlung byung thal bar gtor/ kham̐ las chu byung sbyang byas nas/ slar yang 'bru gsum spro bsdu las/ oṃ dkar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ āḥdamar rak+ta rba klong 'khrugs/ hūm̐ mthing gtor ma 'dod yon rdzas/ kun bzang mchod sprin phung por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+da 'i bar dang*/ rū pa shap+da ghan+dhe ra pa spar+she āḥhūm̐/ des ni sbyor ba'i chos rnams so/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'jin (13) gyis snang srid phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis/ nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs par shar/ srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*/ snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ srog ni rgyu yi ting 'jin hūm̐/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ hūm̐ las e yam̐ ra sum̐ kam̐ 'bar ba'i tshwa tshwa 'khrug pa spros/ 'byung ba phung po nyon mongs lnga/ thams cad chos nyid stong par sbyang/ tshur 'dus yongs su (14)gyur pa las/ e las mthing nag nam mkha'i dbyings/ thams cad 'degs pa'i shugs dang ldan/ yam̐ las rlung dkyil rgya gram ljang*/ ra las khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs/ sum̐ las gser gyi sa gzhi brdal/ kam̐ las ri rab sngo mkhregs steng*/ ram̐ las me dpung gru gsum 'bar/ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gzhob tu bsreg thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas zhing*/ yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag rtsa ba'i hūm̐ las bh+rūm̐ yig chad/ 'phro 'du 'od (15)kyis don gnyis byas/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐/ yongs gyur kun bzang gzhal yas khang*/ phyi ni rin chen sna lngas brtsegs/ nang ni dur khrod gzhal med khang*/ thod pa skam pos 'gram btang zhing*/ ra ri rnying pas brtsigs pa la/ lcang lo rlon pa'i kha bad can/ kun kyang kha nas me chen 'bar/ sna nas 'jigs pa'i dud sprin ldang*/ mig nas gdung ba'i mchi ma byung*/ gnam lcags urmos gzer btab pas/

ba su ta yi zung gis (16)btab/ 'og gzhi mām̐ sa rak+ta'i mtsho/ keng rus rnag khrag tshom bur 'khyil/ nyin mtshan med par me rlung 'tshubs/ lha brgyad ka ba gza' brgyad gdung*/ rgyu skar dral btab klu brgyad gdan/ smug nag mi ro'i thob phubs ni/ zhing chen zhing chung gcal bkram par/ dregs pa pho mo'i lpags pas bkab/ lha chen tsirta'i pho tog spras/ nyi zla'i ka zhu matong khung gsal/ mi'u rigs bzhi spyi blugs su/ bshus pa'i lpags pa'i rgyal mtshan bzhi/ (17)nya chen 'phan dang keng rus gdugs/ rū tra bsgral ba'i tsit+ta'i tog sgo bzhi sbrul nag re bzhi la/ nam mkha' lding dang rus sbal gyi/ ya them ma them rab tu brjid/ chu srin gdug pa'i sgo skyes la/ zhing gi lag pas sgo leb byas/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad/ shar nas bya skad kam̐ skad sgrogs/ lho na ku ku khyi ling zug nub na 'dre med dmar nag 'tshubs/ byang na du sprin cir yang 'thul/ mi ro gsar rnying phyed 'thor (18)gzugs/ bya gcan khrag 'thung rngams par rgyug gsal shing rtse la mi ro 'phyang*/ ro langs gar byed ha ha sgrogs/ keng rus me 'bar 'khrab dang 'phyong*/ pho brang dbus kyi lha yi gnas/ rgya mdud brtsegs pa'i rnam par bsam/ hūm̐ las phyag rgya bzhi spros pas/ pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i steng*/ rū tra khyo shugs dbang med bkug rdo rje tho bas brdung byas te/ pho mo gan rgyal kha sbub bsnol/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas yi ge hūm̐/ skar chen thang du babs pa bzhin/ (19)pho brang tog nas gdan dbus babs/ rnam par shes pa rdo rje bsgom/ sku yi dbyig tu bdag bskyed cig srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ ye shes khro bo 'grub par mjod/ hūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgur gyur/ de las spro bsdu brtan byas te/ rdo rje sems dpa' ku mu mdog spro zhing bsdu ba'i mjad pa brtan/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐/

rang sgra 'brug stong ldir ba bzhin/ dag dang ma dag zhing (20)rnams kun/ g.yo 'gul 'od zer snang bas khyab/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byas nas/ sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ rang sems rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing*/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ ya mtshan che ba'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra kham nag ral pa ni/ gyon la 'khyil zhing srid rtser 'bar/ spyan dmar glog stong 'gyu ba (21)bzhin/ mche ba zangs yag rnon po gtsigs/ rkan sgra gtogs pas khams gsum 'khrugs/ bdud rgyal rnams kyis zhabs la btud/ rdo rje rtse dgu rtsa lnga dang*/ me dpung kha ṭ+wām̐ bsdigs pa'i stabs/ 'khor 'das spyi nas gnon pa yi/ mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril/ rdo rje rin chen gshogs pa gdengs/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad na/ rang 'dra'i khro chung mang pos gtams/ thal tshom rak+ta'i thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris byugs (22)pas brgyan/ glang chen ko rlon zhing chen gos/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol/ thod sbrul rin chen phreng bas brgyan/ thugs kar mchong gur smug po'i nang*/ rang 'dra'i brdzus skyes ye shes sems/ de yi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng*/ rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam/ lte bar ting 'jin sems dpa' hūm̐/ mthing nag spu yis bris pa bzhin/ mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ sgo srung rta mgrin yab yum bcas/ chad pa ma yin rig cing gsal/ rtag (23)pa ma yin ngos bzung med/ snang stong ye nas dbyer med gsal/ oṃ tista tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ ut+pal thod khrag yab la 'khyud/ gzigs sham phyag rgya lnga yis spras/ thod skam dbu rgyan do shal 'phyang*/ spyi bor bhud+dha khrag 'thung dkar/ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ 'khor lo kha ṭ+wām̐ rte'u chung g.yas/ dril bu dung dmar rgyu zhags g.yon/

de bzhin rigs bzhi'i khrag 'thung rnams/ (24)rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*/ rgya gram 'bar ba g.yas dang po/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ka dang rte'u chung*/ dril bu du dmar rgyu zhags g.yon/ zla ba pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ 'gying bag rngams pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud gzhal yas lha ru gyur/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las/ byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'du las/ rgya mdud bar ma'i phyogs mtshams su/ mthing nag hūm̐ yig sbrel ma (25)bcu/ zhu bas khro bcu sprul par bcas/ hūm̐/ steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i steng*/ khro bo rdo rje hūm̐ kā ra/ zhal gsum phyag drug rngams stabs can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ rtsa phyag rdo rje dung dmar dkrugs/ bar pa gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs/ mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril/ sgra 'byin yum dang gnyis su med/ sprul pa phag dang rtsang pa'i mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ garja garja hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar phyogs (26)brgya byin bsnol ba'i steng*/ rdau rje khro bo rnam par rgyal/ dkar dmar sngo zhing snyems ma yum/ bar pa rdo rje 'khor lo 'jin/ sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi ja ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i steng*/ rdo rje khro bo dbyug pa sango/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar sder mo yum/ bar pa dbyug to me dbal bsnams/ sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la dan+t+ra hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho ru gshin rje bsnol (27)ba'i steng*/ rdo rje khro bo gshin rje gshed/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum pa/ dur khrod bdag mo yum dang 'khril/ bar pa dgra s+t+wa dbyug to 'jin/ sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya man+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub srin po khyo shug steng*/ khro mo mi g.yo mgon po smug g.yas dkar g.yon dmar gtun khung yum/

bar pas ral gri zhags pa 'jin/ sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo oṃ badz+ra kro ta ār+ya (28)a tsa la hūm̐/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub tu chu bdag pho mo'i steng*/ rdo rje khro bo rta mchog dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon mthing gtum mo yum/ bar pa ral gri sbrul zhags 'jin/ sprul pa byi la su shud mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang rlung lha khyo shugs steng*/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon ljang mda' snyems yum/ bar pa dbyug to rnga yab 'jin/ sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo oṃ badz+ra kro (29)dha a pa ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang du gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i steng*/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang*/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rlung 'byin yum/ bar pa rgya gram dbyug to 'jin/ sprul pa seng ge pha waṃ mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun ḍa li hūm̐ ts+tshin+ḍa ts+tshin+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar dbang ldan khyo shugs steng*/ khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal por/ g.yas mthing g.yon ljang gsod byed yum/ bar pa rdo rje tri shul 'jin/ sprul (30)pa dred dang sre mong mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi dz+wa ya hūm̐/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i steng*/ khro bo stobs chen dud kha'i mdog g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rig byed yum/ bar pas tho ba gtun shing 'jin/ sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ de ltar khro bo thams cad kyis/ dang pos rdo rje dung dmar dkrugs/ mtha' gnyis ri rab phur pa 'dril/ yum rnams sku mdog yab (31)dang mtshungs/ phyag mtshan dril bu dung dmar 'jin/ sprul pa lcam dral sku mdog ni/ g.yas g.yon zhal gyi kha dog la/ phyag mtshan lcags kyu phar bu 'dril/ rngams brjid 'bar ba'i sku ru gsal/ hūm̐/ rgya mdud 'og ma'i khongs seng la/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis gsal/

jaḥ shar gyi sgo ba pu shud mgo mthing nag g.yas pas lcags kyu 'jin/ hūm̐/ lho yi sgo ba skya ka'i mgo ser po (32)g.yas pas zhags pa 'jin/ bam̐/ nub kyi sgo ba srin bya'i mgo dmar nag g.yas pas lcags sgrog 'ji/ hoḥ byang gi sgo ba khra yi mgo ljang nag g.yas pas dril bu 'jin/ kun kyang g.yon pas phur pa thogs/ rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs par bskyed/ pho brang gzhal yas phyi ma'i khyams/ khrag khyams 'phyo ba'i snal ma la/ mi ro rta ros gang ba'i steng*/ dbang phyug ma mo nyi shu brgyad/ sgo bzhir dung lcags bse'i skyes bu/ tak+ki (33)nag po 'jigs par bskyed/ phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus/ yab yum mnyam sbyor hūm̐ 'phros pas/ sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya/ zhal gcig phyag kyang bzhi pa ste/ s+t+wa re rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ dang*/ phur pa btab pas ngan song 'jig lte ba man chad sku smad ni/ sngo bsang mi bzad 'jigs pa'i tshul/ phur pa gtsum gzhogs ldir ba'i dbus/ bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas kang gi dbus/ (34)rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum bsam/ de yi phyos mtshams khro bo brgyad/ yab yum mgo brnyan bcas pa la/ rgya mdud gong mar hūm̐ kā ra/ logs la rigs kyi sangs rgyas lnga/ 'og mar stobs chen yab dang yum/ phra men sprul par bcas pa dang*/ logs bzhir sgo ma bzhi po dang*/ dbal la phur srung bcu gnyis bskyed/ sems kyi sems nyid phur pa yin/ chos kyi chos nyid phur pa yin/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid phur pa yin/ gsal bar bsgom na bskyed (35)pa yin/ gnyis su med na sbyor ba yin/ lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa yin/ nyams 'og chud na bsgral ba yin/ rig pa ye shes phur pa ste/ sku gcig ngang la sku gsum rdzogs/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha be ta li rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

de nas tshe ba bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ sku stod khro bo chen po la/ lte ba man chad phur pa'i dbal/ (36)'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ thugs la rdo rje gzhon nu 'bar/ ye shes me dpung klong na bzhugs/ drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ btab na lha yang brlag gyur na/ gnod byed rnams la smos ci dgos/ dgra bgegs snying la kī la ya/ zhes gsal snang thon par bya/ hūm̐/ srid pa phur bur bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang*/ (37)rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya jaḥ sa ma ya s+t+wam̐/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ rje btsun ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs shing*/ ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur ro/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ phung po dug lnga gnas sbyangs nas/ rigs lnga ye shes mngon du byas/ khrag 'thung rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur/ slar yang khams gsum srid pa gsum/ me (38)chu rlung gis bsregs gtor sbyangs/ thams cad rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ tshur 'dus sgo srung rta mgrin thim/ de nyid mnyam sbyor bdud rtsi bab/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ ting 'jin sems dpa' hūm̐ la thim/ de las rdo rje chos bdun gyi/ lcags kyi srog rtsa shad kyis skyes/ 'khor 'ad srog la rang dbang bsgyur/ de nas mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ 'dod pa'i (39)yon tan mang pos rab brgyan te/ thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes nas kyang*/ bdag la dngos grub ma lus rtsal du gsol/ jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ pañtsa amṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta pū ja hoḥ pra tīts+tsha khā hi/

gṝ ha na khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ lha yi lha mchog che ba'i lha/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ phrin las thams cad (40)rdzogs pa'i dpal/ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod nas/ jap+da dmigs ni/ hūm̐/ rig pa ye shes phur pa nyid/ gzung 'jin bral ba'i gang nas bzla/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa nyid/ byams dang snying rje'i ngang nas bzla/ lhag pa byang sems phur pa nyid/ mkha' klong rnam par dag par bzla/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa nyid/ las bzhi lhun grub ngang nas bzla/ zhes/ thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor (41)gyi steng du gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing ga'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags phreng mthing nag gis bskor ba las 'od zer mthing dmar gyi dbyibs phur pa 'dra ba che ba ka gdung tsam dang*/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam 'phros pas gang la phog pa rnams nyal gyis brlag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bhig+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phyi ltar bzlas pa'o/ 'od zer nang du 'phros pas (42)nad gdon bsreg par dmigs pa nang ltar bzlas pa'o/ yang 'od zer rtsa sbug tu 'phros pas nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa rnams nyi zer gyis ba mo sbyang pa ltar/ bsam la gsang ba'i bzlas pa'o/ de nas rgyun du bsnyen na dang po bye ba gsum la sogs pa 'gro bar bya'o/ de nas bzhi snying gcig tu dril ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya jaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ka tang ka ye/ ja ye bī ja ye/ a tsi te a pa ra tsi te ma ra se na pra marta na ye/ sarba bhig+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'bum phrag bzhi bzla'o/ spu gri khri bzla'o/ de ltar bzlas pas 'grub pa'i tshad ni/ rgyud las/ (43) rang sems gzhi yi phur pa ni/ sa bon kun khyab til mar 'dra/ rtogs na sangs rgyas ngo mtshar che/ bgrod pa lam gyi phur pa ni/

thabs shes sku gsum ye shes lnga/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i phur pa ni/ sku lnga ye shes dgu ldan te/ ma 'khrul rtogs pa mngon 'gyur bya/ gzhi lam 'bras bu rtogs gyur na/ chos sku spros bral mngon du 'gyur/ zhes so/ de ltar sgrub pa'i gang zag gi rim pa yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkha' lta bu'i gang zag gis/ rig pa ye shes phu+ur pa de/ gzung 'jin med pa'i ngang du gdab/ lhang gis rtogs na thebs pa'i tshad/ 'bras bu chos sku skye med thob/ ma thobs ma rtogs 'khor bar (44) 'khyams/ ri bo lta bu'i gang zag gis/ tshad med snying rje'i phur pa de/ 'gro la byams dang snying rjes gdab/ bdag gzhan gnyis med rtogs na thebs/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku thob/ ma thebs rū tra srin por gol/ 'dab chags lta bu'i gang zag gis/ lhag pa byang sems phur pa de/ yum gyi mkha' klong dag par gdab/ bde ba dngos med thebs pa'i tshad/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbyer med thob/ ma thebs 'khor ba'i 'gram rdo byed/ tsan+da lta bu'i gang zag gis/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa de/ zhi rgyas dbang drag phur pa yin/ khyad par drag po'i phur pa ni/ gnad chen thams cad 'dus pa yi/ dkar nag mtshams su gdab par bya/ zhes pa'i rnam dbye phyed par (45)(46) rang gi rgyud tshod dang mthun par nyams su blang bar bya'o/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod dang bshags pa byed nas/ hūm̐ gsum gyis lha'i gsal snang 'od gsal du bsdu'o/ phaṭa gsum gyis rjes kyi lhar ldang ngo*/ 'di ltar mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyis/ slob dpon rnam gsum dgongs pa'i bcud/ rgyud 'grel phur pa 'bum nag gi rtsa ba'i man ngag mdor bsdus te/ dngos grub bsgrub la mi bslu ba/ rgyun khyen las kyi khrigs nyid du/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bsdebs/ dge bas kun bzang nyid thob shog ces pa'ang sdom brtson ldan pa yi ge dang*/ a tshul/ bsod nams bstan 'jin gsum gyis bskul ngor 'od gsal rin chen snying po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis spel ba dge'o/
